snippet.title: NHL 2K8 - PS2 2007 (2008 Stanley Cup Finals PIT vs DET)
snippet.description:
Sorry the video I posted got blocked so I hurry up and recorded this simulation. I want you guys to know that I'll be posting contents every other day but feel free to leave me a comment for suggestion. I'll tried to post it on my channel. 

This is a 2008 Stanley Cup Finals between the Detroit Red Wings and the Pittsburgh Penguins on NHL 2K8 for PS2 2007.

NHL 2K8 reigns supreme as the category leader in innovation, design and critical acclaim with five straight years as the top-rated NHL video game. In addition to intensely realistic gameplay, all new player models and spectacular graphics, NHL 2K8 will feature an unprecedented level of player customization with accurate body styles for each marquee player, providing the most authentic representation of your favorite NHL stars.
